preflight.recommendedPagefile: Windows system-managed pagefile with at least 32 GiB free on the pagefile volume
preflight.comfyUiHealthCheck: GET /system_stats and a no-op or tiny workflow through the local API

oneTimeQualification.cacheKey: GPU model + VRAM + driver + ComfyUI commit + model hashes
successCriteria: process completes without CUDA OOM or unrecovered worker crash
peak committed system memory remains below a safe threshold
no repeated pagefile thrashing or stalled progress beyond the timeout
oneTimeQualification.selection: first passing candidate in order; persist result and do not repeat unless hardware, driver, runtime, or model hash changes
